verses.translation: A Psalm of David on the occasion of the solemn assembly of the Tabernacle. Bring to the Lord, ye sons of God, bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honour.

translations.ron: Aduceţi Domnului, fii ai lui Dumnezeu, aduceţi Domnului mieii oilor, aduceţi Domnului slavă şi cinste;
translations.grk: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυὶδ ἐξοδίου σκηνῆς. Ἐνέγκατε τῷ Κυρίῳ υἱοὶ Θεοῦ, ἐνέγκατε τῷ Κρίῳ υἱοὺς κριῶν· ἐνέγκατε τῷ Κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν,

verses.translation: Bring to the Lord glory, due to his name; worship the Lord in his holy court.

translations.ron: Aduceţi Domnului slavă numelui Său; închinaţi-vă Domnului în curtea cea sfântă a Lui.
translations.grk: ἐνέγκατε τῷ Κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ· προσκυνήσατε τῷ Κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory has thundered: the Lord is upon many waters.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului peste ape; Dumnezeul slavei a tunat; Domnul peste ape multe.
translations.grk: Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων, ὁ Θεὸς τῆς δόξης ἐβρόντησε, Κύριος ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν.

verses.translation: The voice of the Lord is mighty; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului întru tărie, glasul Domnului întru mare cuviinţă;
translations.grk: Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐν ἰσχύϊ, φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐν μεγαλοπρεπείᾳ.

verses.translation: There is the voice of the Lord who breaks the cedars; the Lord will break the cedars of Libanus.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului cel ce sfărâmă cedrii şi va zdrobi Domnul cedrii Libanului;
translations.grk: Φωνὴ Κυρίου συντρίβοντος κέδρους, συντρίψει Κύριος τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου,

verses.translation: And he will beat them small, even Libanus itself, like a calf; and the beloved one is as a young unicorn.

translations.ron: El face să sară Libanul ca un viţel; iar Ermonul ca un pui de gazelă.
translations.grk: Καὶ λεπτυνεῖ αὐτὰς ὡς τὸν μόσχον τὸν Λίβανον, καὶ ὁ ἠγαπημένος ὡς υἱὸς μονοκερώτων.

verses.translation: There is a voice of the Lord who divides a flame of fire.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului, cel ce varsă para focului.

verses.translation: A voice of the Lord who shakes the wilderness; the Lord will shake the wilderness of Cades.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului, cel ce cutremură pustiul şi va cutremura Domnul pustiul Cadeşului.
translations.grk: Φωνὴ Κυρίου συσσείοντος ἔρημον, συνσσείσει Κύριος τὴν ἔρημον Κάδης.

verses.translation: The voice of the Lord strengthens the hinds, and will uncover the thickets: and in his temple every one speaks of his glory.

translations.ron: Glasul Domnului dezleagă pântecele cerboaicelor, glasul Domnului despoaie cedrii şi în locaşul Lui, fiecare va spune: Slavă!
translations.grk: Φωνὴ Κυρίου καταρτιζομένου ἐλάφους, καὶ ἀποκαλύψει δρυμοὺς, καὶ ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ πᾶς τις λέγει δόξαν.

verses.translation: The Lord will dwell on the waterflood: and the Lord will sit a king for ever.

translations.ron: Domnul va împărăţi peste potop şi va şedea Domnul Împărat în veac.

verses.translation: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

translations.ron: Domnul tărie poporului Său va da, Domnul va binecuvânta pe poporul Său cu pace.
